title: [Bug Fix] #190: Additional-Currency Total Cost incorrect on Project Ledger Entries
summary: Project ledger entries now correctly record additional-currency total cost when a manual source currency exchange rate override is applied, matching G/L entry behavior.
key_points: Carry source currency code and source currency amount from Gen. Journal Line to Job Journal Line during transfer
Skip currency re-conversion when source currency equals additional reporting currency, preserving overridden rates
Ensures project and G/L ledger entries remain consistent for manually overridden exchange rates
Added regression test demonstrating the fix
quote: This fix makes the Job Ledger Entry honour the manually entered source-currency amount.
